summary_en: T.HASEGAWA authorized acquisition of up to 1.3 million shares (3.2% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 3.5 billion yen through market purchases from November 12, 2026 to September 30, 2027, with full cancellation planned for October 29, 2027.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
At its November 11, 2026 board meeting, T.HASEGAWA resolved to authorize the acquisition of up to 1.3 million ordinary shares (3.2% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 3.5 billion yen. The shares will be purchased through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12, 2026 to September 30, 2027. All shares acquired under this authorization will be cancelled effective October 29, 2027.

The company stated that the acquisition and cancellation are intended to implement flexible capital policies in response to changes in the operating environment, enhance capital efficiency, and expand shareholder returns. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 2.1 million treasury shares against 40.6 million outstanding shares.
